chunks: And gave him what is good in the world, and in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous and the good.
ai.seo_question: Who is the prophet referred to as being granted goodness in this world and the Hereafter in Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to Prophet Hud (peace be upon him), emphasizing that divine favor (hasanah) encompasses both worldly prominence and spiritual integrity. It underscores the Shia understanding that true prophetic success is not merely in the Hereafter but includes a dignified worldly presence, affirming his status among the righteous (al-Salihin) as a model of balanced virtue.
